items.name: Himalayas
items.fact: Home to the world’s highest peaks, including Everest.

items.name: Andes
items.fact: Longest continental mountain range on Earth.

items.name: Rocky Mountains
items.fact: Major mountain range of western North America.

items.name: Alps
items.fact: High mountain range across south-central Europe.

items.name: Gobi Desert
items.fact: Cold desert across Mongolia and northern China.

items.name: Amazon River
items.fact: Largest river by discharge; drains the Amazon basin.

items.name: Nile River
items.fact: Often cited as the world’s longest river.

items.name: Mississippi River
items.fact: Principal river of the central United States.

items.name: Great Rift Valley
items.fact: Vast rift system through eastern Africa.

items.name: Grand Canyon
items.fact: Iconic canyon carved by the Colorado River.

items.name: Ural Mountains
items.fact: Traditional boundary between Europe and Asia.

items.name: Atacama Desert
items.fact: One of the driest places on Earth.
